items.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] The way with no way: when grace has struck firm, one word from the teacher and the immersion is ever-risen — no means required. [1] Four impossibilities: no nature to attain, nothing to notify, no covering to remove, no one to enter; the means itself impossible. [2] All is one consciousness-only reality — unmeasured, unbounded, unfaded, uncontrolled, unindicated, unelaborated — autonomous, bliss-dense; I am that, with the universe mirrored in me. [3] No mantra, worship, meditation, or conduct binds one who sees this steadily.
